newsitem.title: USA: Hein-Werner gets multi-year equipment pact.
newsitem.headline: Hein-Werner gets multi-year equipment pact.

text.p: Hein-Werner Corp said Wednesday it will manufacture brake lathes, stands and accessories for John Bean Co under an exclusive, multi-year contract.
The equipment will be manufactured by Hein-Werner's Winona Van Norman unit and will be supplied to John Bean Co on a private label basis.
Joseph L. Dindorf, president and chief executive officer, said the contract is expected to have a positive impact on Winona Van Norman's sales in 1997.
In addition to manufacturing auto brake-related equipment, Winona Van Norman supplies engine rebuilding equipment and custom contract machining.
Hein-Werner manufactures and markets collision repair, engine rebuilding and fluid power equipment.
